violated_contract: A warm-hub voice turn waiting on a chat-lane tool (web_search, think_deeper, ask_higher_model) must keep the 180-second chat-lane pending-tools budget. Applying the 30-second standard-tool deadline terminates a legitimate public-web lookup as toolTimeout, cancels the hub, and the spoken answer falls to cascade or system TTS — a different voice than the live session.
canonical_prevention: The voice-turn reducer stores a per-call deadline class and reschedules pending-tools to chatLaneTool (180s) when any in-flight call is chat-lane. The hub driver selects chatLane for web_search, think_deeper, and ask_higher_model after toolStarted. Behavioral tests assert the 180s reschedule, that mixed pending tools keep 180s, and that the driver arms 180s for web_search while standard tools stay at 30s.
